thread:
robin: quick q for rollout console folks: can we add a per-rule "sampling budget" UI instead of only rate sliders?
robin: idea: teams set a monthly quota (e.g., 10k traces) and the system converts that into an adaptive rate given live QPS.
anita: love that. makes cost predictable. UI would need to show realtime burn rate and projected end-of-day usage.
lee: backend note: budget->rate conversion needs to consider expected bump windows (incidents). we could expose a conservative and a pessimistic projection.
robin: also want a one-click "forensic snapshot" that temporarily overrides budget and captures N traces for debugging. should be gated to admins.
anita: security/retention: default to no payload capture. when payload enabled, store encrypted with tenant KMS and auto-run PII scrubber. retention default 7d, adjustable by support.
lee: sampling decision must be computed before heavy work. propose header X-Rollout-Audit: <decision_id>|sampled=1|rate=0.05|reason=error_class. downstream can check header to capture.
robin: UX thought: place budget control inline with each fallback rule and an overall policy-level cap. show small sparkline of recent error-rate next to it.
anita: add "apply preset" menu: conservative (min cost), ops (forensic-on-alert), dev (high-sample). presets update both budget and include-payload flag.
lee: quota overflow handling: when quota exhausted, reduce effective rate to maintain fairness across tenants and emit audit.quota.exhausted with details. console should surface this alert and a "top-up" action.
robin: simulation: a simulate button that takes last 24h QPS and projects samples and storage cost. also an "estimate for incident" mode that assumes Xx spike for Y minutes.
anita: for replayability store: prompt_hash, kv_keys (list), model_variant, policy_id, fallback_reason, and optional encrypted prompt when enabled. this should be enough to reconstruct.
lee: operational: add metric audit.sample.accepted, audit.sample.dropped_quota, audit.sample.encrypted_stored. and a debug log for sample decisions for 1h after a snapshot.
robin: edgecase: noisy flappy errors. add hysteresis: require N events in T seconds to bump sampling. show the hysteresis config in UI.
anita: admin flow: one-click emergency lift that bumps sampling for selected policies and posts to #oncall. also auto-revert after TTL. show audit trail of who did lift.
infra-bot: scheduled canary run: audit-budget-smoke-1733 on 2024-11-02T01:00:00Z. will report results to #eng-platform.
lee: next steps: i'll spec the header and proto and a cheap edge evaluator. anita will draft retention/redaction defaults. robin will mock the inline budget control + simulate screen.
anita: I'll also add a short checklist for support teams to approve longer retention.
robin: cool — aim to have an RFC draft by Wednesday. tagging @anita @lee. :mag_right:
